courses.title: Change Management for Technical Teams
courses.description: Change Management for Technical Teams focuses on change management for technical teams for people working toward a Data Engineering Lead role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces stakeholder communication, enough to apply alongside change management for technical teams in real Data Engineering Lead work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to change management for technical teams and show how stakeholder communication supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying change management for technical teams to a real Data Engineering Lead scenario
Practicing change management for technical teams through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to stakeholder communication
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Change Management for Technical Teams Essentials
alternates.description: Change Management for Technical Teams Essentials is a short introduction to change management for technical teams for people moving toward a Data Engineering Lead role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show change management for technical teams in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if change management for technical teams is new to you.
learning_outcomes: Applying change management for technical teams to a real Data Engineering Lead scenario
Practicing change management for technical teams through guided exercises
Building a short change management for technical teams exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Change Management for Technical Teams Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Change Management for Technical Teams Techniques is a focused course on change management for technical teams for people already working toward a Data Engineering Lead role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying change management for technical teams on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying change management for technical teams to a real Data Engineering Lead scenario
Practicing change management for technical teams through guided exercises
Building a short change management for technical teams exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
